steps.say: Let's look at one of the most common checkmates in chess: the back-rank mate.
Black's king is tucked behind its own pawns. Those three pawns block every escape square in front of it.
The white rook is on an open file, with nothing between it and the eighth rank.
Rook to e8 is checkmate. The king can't step forward, and nothing can block or capture.
Your turn. Same idea, different position. White to play: find the mate in one.

puzzle.hint: Which white piece can reach the back rank in one move?
